entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-heartbeat
entry.summary: Interval heartbeat that wakes each root agent itself (followup injection) to proactively report progress, risks or blockers: busy-safe queuing, no stacking, auto-pauses when no human replies, re-arms on the next user message. Exact install spec: github:littleblacktong/dsh-plugin-heartbeat. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
